rules.label: partial_range
rules.rest_note: Next set, try lowering until your front thigh is about level with the floor.

rules.label: forward_lean
rules.rest_note: Keeping your chest tall over your hips makes this easier on your back.

rules.label: fast_lowering
rules.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. Around 2 s gives you more control.

tempo.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. A slower 2 to 3 s is gentler on a recovering knee.

knee.extra_note: The depth here is set shorter to suit a recovering knee. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.

shoulder.extra_note: Lunges put little load on the shoulders. Holding the weights at your sides, or using none, keeps it that way.

trunk_lean.rest_note: Your chest tipped forward on {n} reps. A taller chest keeps the load off your lower back.

lower_back.extra_note: The lean limit here is set tighter to go easy on a recovering lower back. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.
